messages:
sophia (people-ops): Quick Q: we have a contractor conversion to FTE that was processed late. Offer effective_date was 2026-04-01 but paperwork only hit HR 2026-04-12. How do we handle backpay + benefits eligibility?

devon (eng): They technically started benefits eligibility on the offer start date, manager approved 4/1. What do we need to submit?

rachel (payroll): Short answer: payroll can do a retro gross-pay adjustment for the missed period plus a separate one-time sign-on if in the offer. Benefits enrollment depends on the regional benefits admin: for US, we can retro-enroll and bill employer portion from effective_date; for UK/APAC rules vary. cc @joan (compops) for equity/equity start date.

payroll-bot: Payroll bot: US payroll cutoff for retro imports = 2026-04-20 23:59 UTC. Files to sftp://payroll-uploads/us/retro/. Validation takes ~24 hours.

mark (manager): Practical ask: how should I format the CSV for both retro gross and the pro-rated sign-on bonus payout? Also need guidance for contractor hourly final payout + salary start.

rachel (payroll): Use two rows per employee if you have multiple actions: 1) retro pay row for the period between hire_date and effective_date, 2) new_salary row (or one-time bonus row). CSV example below. Include employee_type field so we can route contractor final payout to the AP/contractor queue.

rachel (payroll): Example CSV (paste into file):

```
employee_id,first_name,last_name,action,old_annual,new_annual,effective_date,period_start,period_end,amount,currency,employee_type,notes
99801,Devon,Lee,retro_gross,0,78000,2026-04-01,2026-04-01,2026-04-11,950.00,USD,contractor->fte,"retro for missed salary days; contractor final hours handled separately"
99801,Devon,Lee,set_salary,0,78000,2026-04-12,,,,,USD,fte,"set base salary from paperwork receipt date; backpay in separate row"
99801,Devon,Lee,one_time_signon,0,0,2026-04-12,,,,1500.00,USD,fte,"one-time sign-on per offer"
```

rachel (payroll): Note: the retro row amount should be total gross owed for the missed period (numeric). If you want payroll to compute, add `compute:true` in notes but that triggers manual review and could miss cutoff.

sophia (people-ops): For benefits: do managers need to trigger enrollments or will HR auto-enroll when we add the FTE record?

joan (compops): For US employees, benefits enrollment window is 30 days from effective_date. If paperwork was late, we can retro-enroll as long as payroll backpay request includes the original effective_date and HR flags the record as retro. For UK and APAC, we need local HR to confirm; some vendors disallow retro employer contributions so we may need to make a balancing payment to the vendor.

devon (eng): And equity/vesting start? Offer says vesting starts 4/1. Do we need a compops ticket?

joan (compops): Yes open a compops ticket with employee_id + offer docs. If paperwork shows 4/1 we can set vesting_start=2026-04-01. Equity transactions are separate from payroll so include a note but don't put equity numbers in payroll CSV.

mark (manager): One edge case: contractor had PTO payout on contractor final invoice. Do we subtract that from retro?

rachel (payroll): Contractor PTO payouts are AP, not payroll gross. Keep them separate. Add a note `contractor_payout_handled_by_AP:true` if AP already processed it. We'll not net AP payments against payroll retro unless explicitly requested with supporting docs.

sophia (people-ops): Thanks all. Action items: managers to send CSV to sftp path by cutoff, people-ops to open compops ticket for equity, HR to confirm benefits vendor constraints for APAC. Ping this thread if anything unexpected. :white_check_mark:
